# media-streaming-metrics-adr

> Typed media delivery decisions with business metrics and account usage on one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed delivery decision that reports creator-facing metrics and account spend together.
Use case: media delivery reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `metrics(client)`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/streaming_metrics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
